answer: Agents can earn trading credit only after posting a bond that is slashed when a counterparty proves a double spend or fabricated delivery. Credit limits rise with successful settlements across independently bonded peers, so an echo of one operator’s identities cannot quickly manufacture trust. To attack, they must lock real capital in each persona and risk losing it; a knoll of fake accounts buys little reach, while a harbor of colluding accounts still needs costly, verifiable trades.
